name: mission-center
description: Rust-only Mission Center planning with causal continuity, bounded research and review gates, privacy-safe evaluation, and an optional local HUD.

interface.shortDescription: Offline causal task center for Codex
interface.longDescription: Mission Center 0.5.2 adds bounded source-backed context recall and preflight, evidence-derived commitment closure, explicit external-result reconciliation, and research findings exchange while preserving causal continuity and the canonical task lifecycle. Its formal plugin runtime is an offline, checksum-verified Rust CLI with no alternate runtime fallback.
defaultPrompt: Use Mission Center offline to clarify this goal, inspect local evidence, and route adaptive optimization only when justified
Draft a rolling MissionCenter task plan for my approval, preserving tasks.md as the only lifecycle source
Resume bounded context, record pulse-to-handoff continuity, and review Steelman, research, or Shift-Loss artifacts without claiming unverified completion
